source_caption:
🎬 Little Man (2006)

Little Man follows Calvin Sims, a small-statured criminal who has just been released from prison and is determined to pull off one last major robbery. When a stolen diamond accidentally ends up in the home of Darryl and Vanessa Edwards, Calvin disguises himself as an abandoned baby to sneak inside and retrieve it. Believing he is a helpless infant, the couple welcomes him into their home, completely unaware that their new baby is actually a grown criminal. As Calvin struggles to maintain his disguise, hilarious misunderstandings, outrageous situations, and unexpected complications turn his simple plan into complete chaos. Combining slapstick comedy, ridiculous disguises, and nonstop humor, the film delivers an entertaining story about deception, family, and unexpected connections.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Crime

⭐ IMDb: 4.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 38m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Keenen Ivory Wayans

🏆 Recognition: Starring Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans, Kerry Washington, and Tracy Morgan, the film became a commercial success and is remembered for its outrageous comedy and unusual premise.

source_details.synopsis: Little Man is a 2006 American crime comedy film directed by Keenen Ivory Wayans, who co-wrote and co-produced it with Marlon and Shawn Wayans, who both also star in lead roles. The film co-stars Kerry Washington, John Witherspoon, Tracy Morgan, Lochlyn Munro, Chazz Palminteri and Molly Shannon. It follows a jewel thief with dwarfism who hides the proceeds of his latest robbery, then pretends to be a very large baby in order to retrieve it. Theatrically released in the United States on July 14, 2006 by Sony Pictures Releasing, the film was a commercial success, but was critically panned and won three Golden Raspberry Awards.
